text: {"lessons":["I should not sell a stock just to lock in a modest gain; I need to assess its risk and prospects rather than focus on my purchase price.","Doing nothing through repeated account declines did not protect me. I should review whether my holdings and overall risk still fit my plan, even though past price moves do not predict future ones.","I should make each decision deliberately and avoid letting the pain of a loss or the satisfaction of a gain dictate whether I buy, sell, or hold."]}
